texts.facts: 1) By the present Interim Application, the Applicant is seeking several reliefs. 2 4. The daughter of the petitioner and respondent has turned major and, therefore, the issue of her custody has become infructuous. Mumbai 400 061 shall be divided into two equal portions. (i) One portion will be occupied by the petitioner and other portion will be occupied by the respondent. (iii) The expenses of interiors, furnishing and other miscellaneous work shall be borne by each party for their own portion. (iv) The respondent husband shall transfer one portion of the aforesaid matrimonial house in the name of the petitioner by executing proper documents. (v) The respondent is under obligation to clear all the expenses towards society charges, municipal tax, electricity bill, till 30th September, 2022. Ashok Chopra Marg, yari Road, Andheri West. Mumbai 400 061 and the drawings of dividing it into two equal portions on next date. 7. The matter is adjourned for working out the proposal of dividing the matrimonial house into two equal portions The parties were given sufficient time to produce before the court the layout of the said flat and the proposed drawing of dividing it into two equal portions. The petitioner has submitted the drawing and the layout of the said flat. She has also given proposed drawing of the dividing the said flat in two equal portions. However, the respondent is not ready for this arrangement. The marriage between the petitioner and the respondent is dissolved by answering Issue No.6 in affirmative. Hence, following order is passed in continuation to above; ORDER: 8. The respondent shall comply the directions given in the order dated 12.08.2022, thereby transferring equal portion of the said house in the name of the petitioner; Rajesh Ahlawat vs Sharmila Rajesh Ahlawat Nee Sharmila D. ... on 17 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140779111/ 3 OR in the alternative, the respondent shall purchase 2 BHK flat admeasuring 1200 sq.ft. in the area of Andheri or adjoining it, within 3 months from today. 9. The respondent shall deposit Rs.15,00,000/- in his and his daughter's name jointly in any 904. ia 12554-2025.doc nationalized bank which shall be allowed to be withdrawn along with interest by his daughter only at the time of her marriage or when she turn 30 years of age, whichever is earlier. 10. Decree be drawn up accordingly.
texts.arguments: 5) It is informed by the learned Advocate for the Applicant that both the parties have filed Family Court Appeals, challenging the judgment and order dated 21/10/2022 in this Court and the same are pending for admission. 6) Learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant submitted that the marriage between the parties which was solemnized on 18/3/1999, was dissolved by a decree of divorce. Learned Counsel for the Applicant further submits that the Applicant has remarried after the decree of divorce, as, there was no appeal preferred by the Respondent-wife, within the statutory period. She further states that the Applicant resides in Thailand with his wife and two small children and visits India with his family. She states that in 2024, the Applicant suffered a stroke and was admitted to the hospital in India/Thailand and that the Applicant had to undergo 904. ia 12554-2025.doc a surgery for placement of stent to treat his brain occlusion. She states that the Applicant is required to take treatment in India, as the treatment in Thailand is very expensive. She further states that in April 2024, the Applicant along with his newly wedded wife and two children had come to India, however, they were not allowed to stay in the Applicant's flat. Learned Counsel for the Applicant states that the Applicant wants to bring his wife and two children permanently to India, and that the family wants to migrate to India. She states that, hence, the Applicant wants to stay in the flat A/1003/1004, Raj Classic, New Yari Rod, Andheri (West), Mumbai (hereinafter referred to as the 'said flat'), where the Respondent and Applicant were residing. 7) She further states that on the Applicant's trip to India on 8/4/2024, when he came with his wife and two children, the Respondent created a ruckus and threw away all the food items which were prepared for the Applicant's children. She further states that now the Applicant has come to India for the Diwali vacation and wants to stay in the said flat with his family. She 904. ia 12554-2025.doc states that on 24/9/2025 when the Applicant went to the said flat, the mother of the Respondent opened the door and used derogatory words and insulted the Applicant. She states that again when the Applicant went on 26/9/2025, he found that the door was bolted from inside by a safety chain; that when the Applicant tried to enter the house, the Respondent did not permit him to enter the house, as a result of which he had to stay out. Thus, learned Counsel for the Applicant prays that the Applicant be permitted to stay in the said flat with his family who has Rajesh Ahlawat vs Sharmila Rajesh Ahlawat Nee Sharmila D. ... on 17 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140779111/ 4 come with him from Thailand. 8) Learned Counsel appearing for the Respondent-wife on the other hand stated that the Respondent-wife has no objection if the Applicant and his mother come and reside there, however, she has an objection to the Applicant's wife and children coming to the said flat. Learned Counsel for the Respondent states the Respondent has never stopped the Applicant/his mother from visiting the said flat. He states that there are about four rooms in the said flat, one, which is the master bedroom, which is occupied 904. by the Applicant and that the Respondent is using another bedroom and her daughter is using yet another bedroom . He states that one bedroom is not occupied by any one. 9) The learned Counsel for the Respondent stated that if if the Applicant is allowed to bring his wife and children out of the new marriage, it will definitely cause much trauma and concern to her. Learned Counsel for the Respondent, therefore, prayed that the appropriate orders may be passed as against the Applicant and his mother. However, the Respondent staunchly objects newly wedded wife of the Applicant and their children to come and stay in the said flat. The learned Counsel appearing for the Respondent further informs that the Applicant has got another house which is in the name of mother of the Applicant and that the Applicant can very well stay over there. He further informs that the present application is filed merely to harass the Respondent.
